instruction: Look at assign.sch in EAGLE. The <classes> block already defines HSPEED as class number 3. Five nets are present (VCC, GND, CLK, DATA, RESET), all initially at class="0". Task: reassign nets `CLK` and `DATA` to class HSPEED (class number 3). Leave VCC, GND, and RESET unchanged at class 0. Save the schematic as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch`. Requirements: * /home/user/Desktop/answer.sch parses as EAGLE.sch XML. * <net name="CLK"> carries class="3". * <net name="DATA"> carries class="3". * <net name="VCC">, <net name="GND">, and <net name="RESET"> still carry class="0" (unchanged).

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(15); pyautogui.hotkey('shift', 'tab'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter')
